admitted_pool_rationale.C1: baseline_integrity=PASS_with_WARN (flat kstar grid, but Jaccard predicate sound); verdict=supported
admitted_pool_rationale.C2: baseline_integrity=WARN (ablation operator scope mismatch, random-null degenerate); verdict=not-supported
admitted_pool_rationale.C3: baseline_integrity=PASS_with_minor_WARN (length secondary not run, val-eval gap); verdict=not-supported

picked_rationale: C3 (Applied Control) is the pay-off claim — the practical impact claim the entire Location->Causal->Applied framework was designed to earn. Per FINAL_PROPOSAL.md: 'Dominant contribution: a pre-registered matched-budget verification protocol running Location -> Causal -> Applied on one C_e fit'. The whole pipeline exists to support or refute C3. Additionally: (1) C3's not-supported verdict is robust — macro A=0.053 is far below chance, Arm B=0.669; (2) M4 data (Qwen model swap, runs/A4_verify_qwen/) is already on-disk from the main experiment and can serve as the model-swap variant WITHOUT re-running; (3) the model-swap axis directly answers whether the C3 failure is Llama-3.2-3B-specific. C1 (supported) is lower priority for swap verification. C2 (not-supported with operator caveat) is also important but lower than C3 for Stage 2 selection.

stage2_deferred_rationale.C1: Lower importance — localizability is a prerequisite, not the primary contribution. Swap variant would add limited insight given the strong, consistent Jaccard results.
stage2_deferred_rationale.C2: Important integrity caveat (ablation operator mismatch) but max_verify_claims=1 cap. Should be re-verified via /auto-verify <C2> --resume=true with corrected operator in a future iteration.

model_swap_variant_plan.data_reuse: M4 data at runs/A4_verify_qwen/ is the Qwen model-swap variant (120 eval stems x 6 emotions x 3 arms = 2160 judged continuations on Qwen, independently re-tuned hyperparameters on Qwen val fold). This constitutes a valid model-swap variant.
model_swap_variant_plan.rationale: M4 was explicitly designed as a verify-swap-lite for C3. It runs the same three-arm comparison on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct + SEV held-out with independently tuned configs. The result (Qwen A=0.076, B=0.969, C=0.125; A>B: 0/6, A>C: 0/6) is the model-swap verdict.
